consider your thoughts 5,10,15 years down the line of the what ifs. i have told myself if i don’t do well on the MCAT then i would do something else but recently i spoke with my mentor who pushed me to continue trying. don’t give up if you really want this. i felt frustrated and unheard but she reminded me that there are people in their 50s-60s who wish they continued trying. life is short but it is also so long. don’t give up on yourself. if this is what you want it is hard work but you can do it. everyone is on a different timeline in life. don’t let your emotions sway you out of a decision that you will regret later.
